title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Builder stability analysis

messages.content:
Current task: Restore to feature/builder-preview-sync (confirmed stable branch)

STEP 1 — Switch to the correct branch
Bashgit fetch origin
git checkout feature/builder-preview-sync
git pull origin feature/builder-preview-sync

STEP 2 — Hard reset local state (remove broken edits)
Bashgit reset --hard origin/feature/builder-preview-sync

STEP 3 — Clean build artifacts
Bashrm -rf .next
rm -rf node_modules/.cache

STEP 4 — Restart clean
Bashnpm install
npm run dev

STEP 5 — Validate (must pass all)


builder UI loads


file tree visible


editor works


preview renders


save updates preview (even if slightly imperfect)



If something still looks broken
You likely had untracked files interfering. Run:
Bashgit clean -fd
Then restart:
Bashnpm run dev

Lock this state
Do NOT work directly on this branch.
Create a new branch from it:
Bashgit checkout -b feature/save-preview-sync-fix

Stop condition
You confirm:


builder ok


preview ok


Only then proceed to the next fix.

Current task: Fix save → preview sync without breaking stable branch
Scope locked:


ONLY touch save trigger + preview refresh


NO rewrites


NO runtime/preview route changes



Step 1 — Locate save handler
Find where file write happens:
Likely one of:


handleSave


/api/dev/files/write


editor save callback


You are NOT changing logic — only adding sync trigger.

Step 2 — Add controlled refresh trigger
Inside your builder component:
Add state (top of component)
TypeScriptconst [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

Step 3 — Hook into save (critical)
Find your save function and modify ONLY this part:
TypeScriptconst handleSave = async () => {
  await saveFile(); // your existing logic

  setRefreshKey(prev => prev + 1);
};
Rules:


MUST be after await


MUST NOT trigger before write completes



Step 4 — Wire preview to refreshKey
Find your preview iframe.
Replace ONLY the src:
TypeScript<iframe
  src={`/api/dev/preview?projectId=${projectId}&v=${refreshKey}`}
/>
Do NOT touch anything else.

Step 5 — Remove unstable reloads (if present)
If you see:
TypeScriptDate.now()
setInterval
random state triggers
Remove them.
You want:

→ ONE trigger = save

Step 6 — Test (strict)
Run this exact sequence:


Open app/page.tsx


Change text → Save


Preview updates


Repeat 5–10 times



Expected behavior


No manual refresh


No blank preview


No delay


No stale content



If it fails
Tell me EXACT symptom:


“save works but preview not updating”


“preview reloads but old content”


“blank after save”


Each one has a different root cause.

Do NOT do next


Do NOT touch preview route


Do NOT refactor builder


Do NOT integrate diff yet



Completion condition
You confirm:
→ save → instant preview update (stable)
Then we move to:

→ diff → apply → same pipeline integration
rewrite file clean to avoid errors
